on_each_run: Read applicable policy and preserve the existing schedule
Check enabled status and recent execution result when tools permit
Use one AI call for routine checks and a second only for material issues
Do not change, disable, delete, or reschedule existing automations without explicit approval
Report configured, attempted, and verified-success states separately
Never call a paid model API; block provider calls unless this account's free quota and no-billing path are verified
Treat an active provider connection as authentication evidence only, not proof of free quota

github_actions.note: Workflow validates repository policy/tests; it does not itself execute or control the scheduled automation.
